scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @payroll/api" "npm run dev -w @payroll/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @payroll/core && npm run build -w @payroll/api && npm run build -w @payroll/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @payroll/core && npm run typecheck -w @payroll/api && npm run typecheck -w @payroll/web && npm run typecheck -w @payroll/mobile
